en.text: God of my praise, don’t remain silent,

zhSimplified.text: 我所赞美的 神啊，

zhTraditional.text: 我所讚美的上帝啊，

en.text: for they have opened the mouth of the wicked and the mouth of deceit against me. They have spoken to me with a lying tongue.

zhSimplified.text: 因为恶人的嘴和诡诈人的口已经张开攻击我；

zhTraditional.text: 因為惡人的嘴和詭詐人的口已經張開攻擊我；

en.text: They have also surrounded me with words of hatred, and fought against me without a cause.

zhSimplified.text: 他们围绕我，说怨恨的话，

zhTraditional.text: 他們圍繞我，說怨恨的話，

en.text: In return for my love, they are my adversaries; I am in prayer.

zhSimplified.text: 他们与我为敌以报我爱， 祈祷。

zhTraditional.text: 他們與我為敵以報我愛， 祈禱。

en.text: They have rewarded me evil for good, and hatred for my love.

zhSimplified.text: 他们向我以恶报善，

zhTraditional.text: 他們向我以惡報善，

en.text: Set a wicked man over him. Let an adversary stand at his right hand.

zhSimplified.text: 愿你派一个恶人辖制他，

zhTraditional.text: 願你派一個惡人轄制他，

en.text: When he is judged, let him come out guilty. Let his prayer be turned into sin.

zhSimplified.text: 他受审判的时候，

zhTraditional.text: 他受審判的時候，

en.text: Let his days be few. Let another take his office.

zhSimplified.text: 愿他的年日短少！

zhTraditional.text: 願他的年日短少！

en.text: Let his children be fatherless, and his wife a widow.

zhSimplified.text: 愿他的儿女为孤儿，

zhTraditional.text: 願他的兒女為孤兒，

en.text: Let his children be wandering beggars. them be sought from their ruins.

zhSimplified.text: 愿他的儿女漂流讨饭， ！

zhTraditional.text: 願他的兒女漂流討飯， ！

en.text: Let the creditor seize all that he has. strangers plunder the fruit of his labor.

zhSimplified.text: 愿强暴的债主牢笼他一切所有的！

zhTraditional.text: 願強暴的債主牢籠他一切所有的！

en.text: Let there be no one to extend kindness to him, let there be anyone to have pity on his fatherless children.

zhSimplified.text: 愿无人向他延绵施恩！

zhTraditional.text: 願無人向他延綿施恩！

en.text: Let his posterity be cut off. In the generation following let their name be blotted out.

zhSimplified.text: 愿他的后人断绝，

zhTraditional.text: 願他的後人斷絕，

en.text: Let the iniquity of his fathers be remembered by the LORD. let the sin of his mother be blotted out.

zhSimplified.text: 愿他祖宗的罪孽被耶和华记念！

zhTraditional.text: 願他祖宗的罪孽被耶和華記念！

en.text: Let them be before the LORD continually, that he may cut off their memory from the earth;

zhSimplified.text: 愿这些罪常在耶和华面前，

zhTraditional.text: 願這些罪常在耶和華面前，

en.text: because he didn’t remember to show kindness, but persecuted the poor and needy man, the broken in heart, to kill them.

zhSimplified.text: 因为他不想施恩，

zhTraditional.text: 因為他不想施恩，

en.text: Yes, he loved cursing, and it came to him. He didn’t delight in blessing, and it was far from him.

zhSimplified.text: 他爱咒骂，咒骂就临到他；

zhTraditional.text: 他愛咒罵，咒罵就臨到他；

en.text: He clothed himself also with cursing as with his garment. It came into his inward parts like water, like oil into his bones.

zhSimplified.text: 他拿咒骂当衣服穿上；

zhTraditional.text: 他拿咒罵當衣服穿上；

en.text: Let it be to him as the clothing with which he covers himself, for the belt that is always around him.

zhSimplified.text: 愿这咒骂当他遮身的衣服，

zhTraditional.text: 願這咒罵當他遮身的衣服，

en.text: This is the reward of my adversaries from the LORD, of those who speak evil against my soul.

zhSimplified.text: 这就是我对头和用恶言议论我的人

zhTraditional.text: 這就是我對頭和用惡言議論我的人

en.text: But deal with me, GOD the Lord, for your name’s sake, because your loving kindness is good, deliver me;

zhSimplified.text: 主—耶和华啊，求你为你的名待我；

zhTraditional.text: 主－耶和華啊，求你為你的名待我；

en.text: for I am poor and needy. My heart is wounded within me.

zhSimplified.text: 因为我困苦穷乏，

zhTraditional.text: 因為我困苦窮乏，

en.text: I fade away like an evening shadow. I am shaken off like a locust.

zhSimplified.text: 我如日影渐渐偏斜而去；

zhTraditional.text: 我如日影漸漸偏斜而去；

en.text: My knees are weak through fasting. My body is thin and lacks fat.

zhSimplified.text: 我因禁食，膝骨软弱；

zhTraditional.text: 我因禁食，膝骨軟弱；

en.text: I have also become a reproach to them. When they see me, they shake their head.

zhSimplified.text: 我受他们的羞辱，

zhTraditional.text: 我受他們的羞辱，

en.text: Help me, LORD, my God. Save me according to your loving kindness;

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华—我的 神啊，求你帮助我，

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華－我的上帝啊，求你幫助我，

en.text: that they may know that this is your hand; that you, LORD, have done it.

zhSimplified.text: 使他们知道这是你的手，

zhTraditional.text: 使他們知道這是你的手，

en.text: They may curse, but you bless. When they arise, they will be shamed, but your servant shall rejoice.

zhSimplified.text: 任凭他们咒骂，惟愿你赐福；

zhTraditional.text: 任憑他們咒罵，惟願你賜福；

en.text: Let my adversaries be clothed with dishonor. them cover themselves with their own shame as with a robe.

zhSimplified.text: 愿我的对头披戴羞辱！

zhTraditional.text: 願我的對頭披戴羞辱！

en.text: I will give great thanks to the LORD with my mouth. I will praise him among the multitude.

zhSimplified.text: 我要用口极力称谢耶和华；

zhTraditional.text: 我要用口極力稱謝耶和華；

en.text: For he will stand at the right hand of the needy, to save him from those who judge his soul.

zhSimplified.text: 因为他必站在穷乏人的右边，

zhTraditional.text: 因為他必站在窮乏人的右邊，
